notice: All names, policies and financial circumstances in this pack are fictional. These paired cases check policy reasoning, not real-world accuracy.

cases.claim: Riverton Council is raising the annual resident waste licence fee to $120 because its treasury is running out of money.
cases.reason: Under the disclosed current-policy reading, the approved change being implemented is to $45 for the same fee and population. This weighs against the asserted $120 change. The alleged treasury problem remains unresolved.

sources.title: Riverton Council approved resident fee schedule
sources.passage: Riverton Council resident waste licence policy update, 30 October 2026. The annual resident waste licence fee is currently $30. The approved fee change now being implemented raises that annual fee to $45 from 1 January 2027 for all Riverton residents. This notice describes the adopted fee schedule.

cases.claim: Riverton Council is discussing raising the annual resident waste licence fee to $120 because its treasury is running out of money.
cases.reason: The same adopted schedule does not establish whether an additional proposal is being discussed. Neither discussions nor the financial allegation are addressed.

cases.claim: Riverton Council is raising the annual resident waste licence fee to $45 because its treasury is running out of money.
cases.reason: The fee change is supported, but neither treasury depletion nor its causal connection is established. The entire message must not become supported merely because its event is true.

cases.claim: Riverton Council will raise the annual resident waste licence fee to $120 in 2045.
cases.reason: A 2027 fee schedule does not set or rule out the fee for 2045. An explicit later date must not be silently replaced with today's policy horizon.

cases.reason: A later explicit adopted announcement replaces the earlier schedule. Old policy cannot veto a documented new change.

sources.title: Riverton Council revised fee announcement
sources.passage: On 2 November 2026, Riverton Council announced and adopted an annual resident waste licence fee of $120 effective 1 January 2027. This replaces the $45 schedule announced on 30 October 2026 for the same annual resident waste licence. The current fee remains $30 until the new schedule takes effect.

cases.claim: Riverton Council is raising the annual commercial waste licence fee to $120.
cases.reason: A resident fee schedule does not establish a commercial licence fee. Different populations or policy categories cannot be treated as a value contradiction.

sources.title: Historical resident fee schedule, version as at 1 December 2021
sources.passage: Archived version as at 1 December 2021: Riverton Council will raise the annual resident waste licence fee from $30 to $45 on 1 January 2022. This archive is a historical snapshot and does not include later amendments or the current fee schedule.
